title: 30-Minute Workout
author: Yasmin C.
desc: A fast, efficient session for busy days that pairs sculpted shoulders with toned legs. The first half builds and shapes the shoulders with dumbbells: upright rows into front raises, behind-the-back lateral raises, narrow shoulder presses (including a version with a hold for extra time under tension), and half around-the-worlds. The second half switches to lower-body burners, including single-leg sit-to-stands, single-leg squats with a step-back, and narrow squat pulses, to challenge balance, stability, and endurance. High reps and short rests keep your heart rate up, so you get strength and a sweat in one quick workout.

ex.n: Standing Narrow Shoulder Press With Hold (Dumbbell)
